title: A rule for quantizing chaos?
read_scope: Abstract, §§2–3 and the concluding scope of the resummation.
main_result: Obtains a proposed finite periodic-orbit resummation for approximate spectral determinant zeros of an already posed chaotic system.
selection_reason: Distinguishes a regularized resolvent trace and semiclassical resummation from an exact zeta spectral measure.

title: Landau Levels and Riemann Zeros
read_scope: Abstract and lowest-level count, continuum normalization and scope of higher-level proposal.
main_result: Recovers a regulated smooth missing-state count from a lowest-Landau-level model.
selection_reason: Separates continuum subtraction from discrete eigenvalue counting.

title: H=xp Model Revisited and the Riemann Zeros
read_scope: Abstract, operator and boundary conditions (8)–(14), phase normalization and asymptotic counting (15)–(16).
main_result: Studies a modified xp model with an extension phase and Bessel spectral equation reproducing the average zero count.
selection_reason: Tests domains and boundary phases behind a concrete smooth-spectrum operator.

title: The Riemann Zeros as Spectrum and the Riemann Hypothesis
read_scope: Opening scope, §§X–XIV mirror matching, extension phase and small-reflection limit.
main_result: Proposes Rindler Dirac spectral levels through mirror matching and a phase tuned using zeta.
selection_reason: Requires separating one fixed operator, individual phase choices and spectral limits.

title: Hamiltonian for the Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
read_scope: Formal shift similarity, Hurwitz recurrence, proposed boundary condition and metric discussion, pp. 2–4.
main_result: Proposes a formal non-Hermitian Hilbert–Pólya Hamiltonian and conditionally connects a rigorous self-adjoint realization to RH.
selection_reason: Distinguishes formal eigenfunctions from a self-adjoint domain and normalizable states.

title: Comment on “Hamiltonian for the Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function”
read_scope: Complete three-page comment and references. Independently checked half-line deficiency indices and shift range projection.
main_result: Identifies ordinary half-line L² obstructions to self-adjoint momentum and to the proposed Hurwitz candidates.
selection_reason: Provides a checkable domain objection with an author reply that delimits its scope.

title: Comment on ‘Comment on “Hamiltonian for the zeros of the Riemann zeta function” ’
read_scope: Complete two-page reply, Issues 1–4 and references. Checked agreement on the ordinary-space facts and limits of the dispute.
main_result: Clarifies that the original paper does not prove reality and proposes an alternative biorthogonal inner product.
selection_reason: Prevents extending the ordinary-space objection to an unproved no-go for all phase metrics.

title: Metric completion of the Bender–Brody–Müller Hamiltonian: dilation spectrum and missing eigenstates
read_scope: Metric definition, completion theorem and missing-state argument independently checked. Transported-core deficiency classification not audited.
main_result: In one specified half-line shift-metric completion, the critical-line Hurwitz candidates fail the state-space norm.
selection_reason: Pins the obstruction to a concrete completion while retaining its scope.

title: The Schrödinger Operator with Morse Potential on the Right Half Line
venue: Communications in Number Theory and Physics 3(2), 323–361
read_scope: Abstract and Theorems 2.1, 3.2, 4.1 on limit point behavior, counting law and Whittaker model.
main_result: Proves an explicit self-adjoint model and its smooth Weyl law, with a distinct special-function zero model.
selection_reason: Shows an exact domain-and-measure realization with a Riemann-style smooth count.

title: A scattering theory for automorphic functions
venue: Séminaire Équations aux dérivées partielles, École Polytechnique 1973–1974, exposé 23, pp. 1–7
read_scope: Printed pp. XXIII.4–6, energy-space and causal factorization, Eqs. (20)–(24) visually checked.
main_result: Identifies a modular scattering coefficient whose meromorphic poles are related to the zeta zeros.
selection_reason: Contrasts true resonance locations with ordinary point-spectrum spectral measures.

title: Eigenvalue-by-Eigenvalue Comparison of a Sierra–Rodríguez-Laguna-Type Spectrum with the Riemann Zeros
read_scope: Abstract, fixed-phase Bessel equation and numerical/smooth offset comparison.
main_result: Compares 606 SR-type numerical model levels with zeta-zero ordinates and analyzes a smooth offset.
selection_reason: Tests the difference between a smooth spectral staircase and the fluctuations of individual zero ordinates.
